about.story: The EGG Alumni Network was established in 2013 as a platform to unite graduates of EGG Academy, fostering collaboration and continued development among alumni. The network builds on the collective efforts of its members to promote meaningful change in their communities.
mission: To collaborate with individuals and civil society organizations, building a robust network dedicated to strengthening community development.
To enhance capacity-building initiatives, raise environmental awareness, and implement small and microcredit programs to support local economies.
To organize fundraising activities and youth social gatherings, encouraging active participation in communitydevelopment
about.vision: To contribute to a stronger and more resilient society by fostering community development grounded in mutual respect, shared responsibility, and accountability.
